claim: On main, once our queen starts a turn on a narrow tile she stays on narrow tiles for 3 or more consecutive turn starts about five times as often as their queens do (stays begun in raw rounds 101-200), in both halves and both rating bands; per turn inside such long stays the two queens die equally often; it is not our own dragons that hold her there.
how_to_count: Games with our_code main (v31 as a second slice), layouts with queen_spawn_dead_end false and map_key not 'Portals #1'. Queen = lowest initial dragon id of a side. Narrow tile = a tile with two or fewer of its four edges free of kelp (a portal edge counts as open; dragons ignored). At every turnStart of a living queen note whether her head tile is narrow. A stay = a maximal run of consecutive turn starts of that queen on narrow tiles; its round is the raw round of the first of them, its length the number of turn starts. It ends when she starts a turn on a wider tile, when she dies before her next turn start (ended in death), or at the end of the game. Count per side: stays begun in raw rounds 101-200, and those of length 3 or more (long). Slices on main: time before / from 2026-10-06T14:48:15Z, opponent_rating 1700-1899 and 1900-2099; one opponent left out; one layout left out; without Maze, weakhold and Tower Defense. Own-dragon flag for a stay: at some turn start of it a body tile of ANOTHER dragon of her side lies on a tile next to her head through an open side (non-kelp edge, a portal edge followed to its partner tile). All rounds on main: long stays per side, how many end in her death (with the engine reason), queen turn starts inside long stays, all queen turn starts and all queen deaths.

claim: Our lone queen dies about 1.9 times as fast per lone turn against opponents that bring 3 or more short dragons within 12 path steps of her at her fresh turns as against opponents that bring under 1.5, on main and on v31; we do not lose more games to the first kind.
how_to_count: Games with our_code main or v31, layouts with queen_spawn_dead_end false and map_key not 'Portals #1'. Lone-queen turn of ours = a turnStart of our queen at raw round 100 or later while their queen died in an earlier round. Seen = at that turn start a head of the other side is within 3 columns and 3 rows (wrapped) of any tile of her body; the seen test is made at every lone turn start of hers from the round their queen died, also before round 100. Fresh = seen at one of her turn starts in the last 20 rounds (this one included). At each fresh turn count the other side's dragons of length 4 or less whose head is within 12 path steps of her head (kelp blocks, portals pass, dragons ignored). Group games by (opponent_id, our_code); keep pairs with 150 or more fresh turns; bring = that count summed over fresh turns divided by fresh turns. Kind A = bring 3.0 or more, kind B = under 1.5. For each kind: lone turns of ours from round 100 summed, and deaths = games in which our queen died at raw round 100 or later after their queen had died in an earlier round. Rate = deaths per 1,000 lone turns. Beside it: our game results (all games of that opponent and code in rows.jsonl) per kind.
